Elasticsearch is part of 8 of my public repositories, from 2015 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (3), [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (3) and [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (2).

Most recently: [docks](@/work/docks.md): Repository containing useful Dockerfile(s); [microcrawler-elixir](@/work/microcrawler-elixir.md): Microcrawler Implemented in Elixir; [microcrawler-js](@/work/microcrawler-js.md): Scrapping made easy.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Elasticsearch: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Elasticsearch to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
